scope: Native Decision intent stage only. No generative baseline planner, retrieval, answer generation or saved configuration mutation.

new.force_policy: requires successful call and same complete semantic gate as adaptive; otherwise explicit uncertain_decision
new.consistency: required implies helpful and excludes forbidden; positive required plus negative helpful is conflict, uncertain helpful abstains; agreement is semantic consistency, not independent correctness evidence

order: For each case and provider, alternate old/new and new/old by case index; reverse provider order on odd cases.
failure_policy: Keep every failure; no retry, no replacement, no output overwrite. A failure does not count as an abstention or a correct decision.
limits: Human labels are a small diagnostic rubric, not independently adjudicated.
Provider previews may change. Latencies include transport and are one observation each.
Model signals are not correctness labels. No calibration or final RAG quality claim.
Partial eligibility is a counterfactual policy signal, not proof that a real planner needed an addition.
Old policy cannot explicitly represent forbidden; absent capability is reported, not fabricated from unnecessary.
purpose: Ten new design-informed heldout cases; independent of prior 20 labels and calls. Correctness remains limited to human rubric.
